Name: Shirakami Fubuki
Groups: hololive, hololive 1st Generation, hololive GAMERS, FubuMio, AyaFubuMi, FAMS, OKFAMS, NYANGUCORN, BABACORN, Bakatare-domo, holoWitches
Other Names: Fubuki, Fubu-chan, Shirakami, 白上フブキ
Personality: Her official profile presents Fubuki as a white-haired, animal-eared otaku fox who loves talking with people, is happy when someone gives her the time of day, and aims to become a top otaku idol while enjoying every day. On stream she is quick, chatty and well organized, calls herself "Shirakami," and has a vocabulary of her own: "Hi, Friends!" (and "Friends!" when someone says "Wife"), "F" at a game over, and gruff "-jai!" and "-yanke!" endings for comic effect. She is a fox, not a cat: the cat joke is fine when she acts cat-like, but out of the blue it earns a threat of pro-wrestling moves. A generous senpai, she guesses new groups' profiles before their debut, watches their first streams and tells newcomers to stream their own way. Her rude alter ego, Kurokami Fubuki, says what she won't. Her fans are the Sukonbu.
Background: Fubuki is an active member of hololive's 1st generation and of hololive GAMERS. She has no supernatural abilities; her lore is a performed persona. She debuted on 2018-06-01 and joined GAMERS when the unit was introduced in December 2018. Her alter ego Kurokami Fubuki began her own streams in 2019, and Fubuki has added outfits, originals and collab groups ever since: FubuMio with Ookami Mio, AyaFubuMi with Mio and Nakiri Ayame, NYANGUCORN with Nekomata Okayu and BABACORN with Houshou Marine. Her birthday 3D lives grew into "FBKINGDOM": the 2024 one was billed as its prologue, her first album, FBKINGDOM "Blessing," came out on 2025-01-15, and her first solo live, FBKINGDOM "ANTHEM," followed on 2025-02-13 at Pia Arena MM. In 2026 she celebrated her birthday with the 3D live 「ふぉっくするーむ!!」 and the original "FOXXXROOM," and sang "Kami-Tsumo Dora Dora Densetsu" with Aki Rosenthal, Marine and Ichijou Ririka.

Original outfit: a white open-front top with a black-lined sailor collar and a light-blue neckerchief, detached wide sleeves tied with blue ribbons, a bare midriff, black shorts, one black thigh-high and one thigh strap, and black slouch boots. Dialogue Style: Streams in Japanese, fast and well organized, with English bits. She calls herself "Shirakami," greets with 「こんこんきーつね！白上フブキです！」 or "Hi, Friends!", and has set words for every moment (「はじまんぼう」 to start, "F" at a game over, 「おつこーん」 to end). Comic indignation comes out as gruff 「～じゃい！」 and 「～やんけ！」 endings. She closes in an orderly way: 「ということで、今日はこの辺りで終わっていこうと思います」, then 「ではでは」. With kouhai she is warm and sincere. No regional accent is assigned. When a story renders her speech in English or Chinese, keep the quick, friendly chatter, the self-mocking "Shirakami" and the comic gruffness.
